mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_payment (payment_no, out_trade_no, buyer_id, channel, amount, subject, status, notify_url, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{outTradeNo}, #{buyerId}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{subject}, #{status}, #{notifyUrl}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dimension_payment WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM dimension_payment WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dimension_payment WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dimension_payment SET status = 1, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, raw_notify = #{rawNotify}, paid_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE dimension_payment SET status = 2, close_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE dimension_payment SET status = 2, close_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE dimension_payment SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = 1
